verdict.rationale: The evidence documents general payroll creation, preview, approval and deletion (check-docs-3), and lists voids as a feature (check-docs-35). Nothing documents off-cycle payrolls run outside the regular schedule for bonuses, corrections or terminations. Generic payroll creation and voids are adjacent capabilities, not evidence of off-cycle runs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run an off-cycle payroll for bonuses, corrections, or terminations outside the regular schedule
